title: Identity authentication followed by process start and lateral movement
hypothesis: A leaked identity that authenticates successfully, starts an observed process, and then moves laterally within a short span warrants investigation.

finding.title: Identity session progressed from authentication to lateral movement
finding.reason: An observed successful authentication, process start, and lateral movement share one identity reference.

metadata.limitations: Uses only observed event_type and auth_result. It does not use attacker success labels or process maliciousness labels.
